title: Prefix reuse goldenpaperc
summary: Understand exact prefix reuse and test its limitations.
body:
## Problem and approach

Prefix caching reuses exact matching tokens before the changing question. [E1]

## Evidence and limitations

A stable prefix can reduce repeated work. Measure hit rate and repeated latency rather than assuming a universal speedup.

## Reading route

Inspect the controlled comparison in [[cache-notes]] and ask which confounders remain.

Asked again in a session: a matching prefix is reused when only the question changes. [E2]

The reader noted a doubt about this comparison. [E3]
note: Added what the reader's note says.
